summary: Preserved structured partial tool results through the existing tool.updated event end-to-end. Added an optional `result` to the protocol schema, normalized partial results in the backend pi-event-translator only when details were defined, and updated the frontend agent-event-reducer to store partial results while keeping status running and preserving prior results on text-only updates. Added tests for both layers and verified formatting, type-checking, repository file-length guards, and the targeted test suites pass.
decisions: Added an optional `result` field to the `tool.updated` event in `packages/protocol/src/events.ts` rather than introducing a new event type, to keep changes scoped to the existing pipeline.
In `pi-event-translator.ts`, called `normalizeToolResult(event.partialResult)` only when `details` is defined, avoiding double-normalization for plain text partials.

In `agent-event-reducer.ts`, stored the partial `result` on the tool entry while status remains `running` and preserved the existing prior result when an update carries no result, so updates without details cannot wipe a previously emitted partial.

Did not bump the protocol version: the new field is optional and optional fields are checked against the shape on the client side, so no coordinated shape migration is required, though older strict validators will not accept updates containing `result`.
Tightened comments in `pi-event-translator.ts` to bring the file under the 300-line repository guard, without changing behavior.
errors: `pnpm check:loc` initially failed because `apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-event-translator.ts` exceeded the 300-line limit; fixed by trimming comments, after which the guard passed (file at 300 lines).
